note: BH-8766: the most Blocked-by parents the starve collector reads for one starved ticket (2 GitHub GETs each per tick). A ticket with more distinct parents is not dropped: no parent is read, the list counts as unread, and the ticket-starved record goes out with dep_unread once the ticket has been queued UNBLOCK_STACK_PARENT_STALE_H hours. A value outside 1..50 is the code fallback 5.
